title: UAPx becomes Project X at University at Albany

plain: A research group called UAPx, set up to study unexplained objects in the sky with scientific instruments, has been dissolved and its work moved to the University at Albany in New York, where it is now called Project X. A scientist named Kevin Knuth, who was part of the original group, tells Michels this himself, naming colleagues including Matthew Szydagis, Cecilia Levy and Tony Gorman. The move would put the study of such sightings inside a university.
